title: Queue Reconstruction by Height
statement:
You are given an array of people, `people`, which are the attributes of some people in a queue (not necessarily in order). Each `people[i] = [hi, ki]` represents a person of height `h_i` with exactly `k_i` other people in front who have a height greater than or equal to `h_i`.

Reconstruct and return the queue that is represented by the input array `people`. The returned queue should be formatted as an array of pairs.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Next N lines: two space-separated integers `h` and `k`.
outputFormat: Print exactly N lines, each having `h k`.

examples.explanation: Person (5,0) has no taller ahead. Person (7,0) has no taller ahead. Person (5,2) has two taller (5 and 7). And so on.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
people = [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
# Greedy: Sort tallest first, then insert into array by k index
